TWO stacked causes: (1) mapType==='grid' gate hid the control from hex maps entirely (removed); (2) the REAL slider killer - Obsidian 1.13 addSlider now creates span.slider-value BEFORE input.slider, and NativeControls.useNativeControl moved only controlEl.firstChild out of its throwaway Setting, grabbing the span and discarding the input (toggles/dropdowns single-child, unaffected). Fixed by moving ALL controlEl children. Live-verified: grid map slider visible+interactive (label tracks value), hex map slider now present. check + 2106 unit tests green, deployed.

Trackpad navigation implemented in handleWheel (useCanvasInteraction): ctrl/meta+wheel = pinch zoom (smooth multiplicative exp(-deltaY*0.005), per-event factor clamped 0.8-1.25); plain wheel classified by isTrackpadPanWheel heuristic (pixel deltaMode + horizontal component or |deltaY|<50 = trackpad pan; line/page mode or large quantized verticals = mouse notch step zoom). Pan reuses drag-pan rotation/scale math, document-scroll direction. Mode is sticky per wheel gesture (wheelModeRef, cleared on settle/pointer-takeover) so fast flings cannot flip pan into zoom mid-gesture. 5 new unit tests on the heuristic (2111 total green). Live-verified all 3 routes with synthetic WheelEvents - deltas matched theory to 4 decimals. Works for Windows Precision touchpads too (same Chromium event shape). Real-hardware feel check on a physical trackpad pending user.

Seamless subhex zoom shipped. Dive: zoom pinned at MAX_WHEEL_ZOOM (4) + further zoom-in over a hex with an EXISTING sub-map (never creates) -> dispatches windrose:enter-sub-hex with a viewOverride opening the sub-map at LIVE-canvas fit zoom (stored fit was computed at creation-time canvas size and can sit inside the surface zone - caused instant bounce-out until fixed). Surface: new windrose:exit-sub-hex event, dispatched when zooming out below fit*0.5 inside a subhex (isInSubHex threaded via MapStateContext -> usePanZoomCoordinator -> useCanvasInteraction); listener in useCustomEventHandlers. 600ms cooldown; sticky wheel-mode preserved; wired into BOTH wheel/pinch and touch-pinch paths (touch ends its gesture cleanly on transition). Chains through nesting. Live-verified dive at fit 0.74 + 3-tick hysteresis surface back to the pre-dive parent view. check + 2111 unit tests green, deployed. Note: testing created an empty sub-map at hex 0,0 on 'Test Hex Map (Pointy)'.
